events.text: Prince Alexander Albert Victor of Battenberg was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: born Prince Alexander Albert Victor of Battenberg ; 23 November 1886

events.text: Alexander Mountbatten died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 23 November 1886 – 23 February 1960

events.text: Prince Alexander was born at Windsor Castle in Berkshire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Prince Alexander was born in 1886 at Windsor Castle in Berkshire

events.text: He was styled His Highness under a Royal Warrant passed by his grandmother Queen Victoria.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 13 December 1886 , he was styled His Highness under a Royal Warrant passed by his grandmother Queen Victoria

events.text: He was baptised in the White Drawing Room of Windsor Castle.
events.subject: self
events.object: White Drawing Room of Windsor Castle
events.quote: He was baptised in the White Drawing Room of Windsor Castle on 18 December 1886

events.text: Prince Alexander passed a qualifying examination to become service cadet in the Royal Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Prince Alexander passed a qualifying examination to become service cadet in the Royal Navy in March 1902

events.text: He joined the cadet training ship HMS Britannia at Dartmouth.
events.subject: self
events.quote: joined the cadet training ship HMS Britannia at Dartmouth on 8 May 1902

events.text: He served in the Royal Navy from 1902.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served in the Royal Navy from 1902 to 1908

events.text: His service in the Royal Navy ended in 1908.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served in the Royal Navy from 1902 to 1908

events.text: He became one of the earliest members of The Castaways Club.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1910 , became one of the earliest members of The Castaways Club

events.text: He joined the British Army.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1909 , he joined the British Army

events.text: He was appointed Second Lieutenant (on probation) in the Grenadier Guards.
events.subject: self
events.quote: being appointed Second Lieutenant ( on probation ) in the Grenadier Guards on 4 August 1909

events.text: He was confirmed in the rank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was confirmed in the rank on 22 November 1911

events.text: He was promoted to Lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was promoted to Lieutenant on 15 August 1913

events.text: He was seconded to the staff to act as an extra aide-de-camp.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was seconded to the staff to act as an extra aide-de-camp on 10 April 1915

events.text: He was promoted to captain.
events.subject: self
events.quote: promoted to captain the same year

events.text: He was authorised to wear the insignia of the Russian Order of St Vladimir, fourth class with Swords.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 June 1917 , he was authorised to wear the insignia of the Russian Order of St Vladimir , fourth class with Swords

events.text: He resigned his commission.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He resigned his commission on 19 June 1919

events.text: The Marquess joined the Royal Air Force and was commissioned an acting pilot officer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Marquess joined the Royal Air Force and was commissioned an acting pilot officer on 6 June 1941

events.text: He was regraded as a pilot officer (on probation).
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 6 August , he was regraded as a pilot officer ( on probation )

events.text: He was confirmed in his rank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was confirmed in his rank on 6 June 1942

events.text: He was promoted to flying officer (war-substantive).
events.subject: self
events.quote: was promoted to flying officer ( war-substantive ) on 6 August 1942

events.text: He relinquished his commission.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He relinquished his commission on 21 May 1945

events.text: Prince Alexander became Sir Alexander Mountbatten.
events.subject: self
events.quote: As such , Prince Alexander became Sir Alexander Mountbatten .

events.text: He was created Marquess of Carisbrooke, Earl of Berkhamsted and Viscount Launceston.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 7 November 1917 , he was created Marquess of Carisbrooke , Earl of Berkhamsted and Viscount Launceston .

events.text: He married Lady Irene Denison at the Chapel Royal of St Jamess Palace.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 July 1917 , he married Lady Irene Denison

events.text: Lord and Lady Carisbrooke had one child, a daughter Lady Iris Mountbatten.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Lady Iris Mountbatten ( 13 January 1920

events.text: Lord Carisbrooke died aged 73 at Kensington Palace.
events.subject: self
events.quote: died in 1960 , aged 73 , at Kensington Palace

events.text: His ashes were buried within the Battenberg Chapel in St. Mildreds Church, Whippingham on the Isle of Wight.
events.subject: self
events.quote: his ashes were buried within the Battenberg Chapel in St . Mildreds Church , Whippingham on the Isle of Wight

events.text: The title Marquess of Carisbrooke became extinct upon his death.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The title Marquess of Carisbrooke became extinct upon his death
